highlights.headline: No mention of fossil fuels in latest COP31 draft deal
highlights.summary: One of the most fraught debates at the UN climate talks in Turkey has revolved around the future of coal, oil and gas. Now, all mention of fossil fuels has been removed from the summit's new draft agreement.

highlights.headline: COP31 Bulletin Day 11: Countries decry cover text for omitting fossil fuels

sections.title: Beyond Climate — Other Major EU News

items.title: Europe ready for talks with Russia on ending war in Ukraine, leaders say
items.description: European allies of Ukraine say they have a "united" negotiating position at a summit in Berlin.

items.title: EU and UK strike 'landmark deal' to strengthen ties after Brexit
items.description: The European Union and the United Kingdom have agreed on "landmark" deals on youth mobility and trade. Leaders on both sides praised the agreement as they seek to rebuild ties.

items.title: New Ukraine talks including Europe to be held 'soon' — Merz
items.description: Germany's Chancellor Friedrich Merz says European leaders could take part in fresh Ukraine talks on "neutral ground." The UK and EU countries have urged a seat at the table in meetings between the US, Russia and Ukraine.

items.title: European leaders present united front in push for peace in Ukraine
items.description: Talks in Berlin end with reaffirmed support for Kyiv and a concerted push for European representation at future peace talks to end Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

items.title: EU Commission confirms it was targeted in cyberattack using AI tools
items.description: The European Commission was targeted by an "AI-generated cybercampaign," a spokesperson has said. This is the first time the bloc has publicly reported an AI-based cyberattack.
